title: Flower Dragon Sorceress
description: A hooded figure in a purple cloak kneels before an enormous glowing purple and yellow flower, reaching out to touch its center. In the background a witch-like sorceress stands atop a long serpentine dragon with glowing yellow patterns, holding a glowing staff before a gothic cathedral under a starry purple night sky filled with butterflies.
prompt: A hooded figure in a flowing purple cloak kneels on stone pavement reaching toward the glowing center of a massive purple and yellow flower. In the background a sorceress in robes stands atop a long serpentine dragon covered in glowing yellow patterns, holding a star-topped staff. Behind them rises a detailed gothic cathedral under a deep purple starry sky filled with floating butterflies, dramatic fantasy scene, rich textures and luminous details
